title: Design and Develop Science Missions
scope: Systems Engineering, 4 Core Mission Segments (Launch, Space, Ground, User), NPR 7120.5F / NPR 7120.8A

title: General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT)
scope: Orbital mechanics, Tsiolkovsky delta-v, Hohmann transfer, plane changes, J2 perturbations

title: Concept Maturity Levels (CMLs)
scope: CML 1-6 Pre-Phase A to Phase A advancement gates, Science Traceability Matrix (STM), mass and cost margins

title: Mission Design Lab (MDL)
scope: 16 spacecraft disciplines: ADCS, Propulsion, Power, Thermal, Structures, Avionics, Comms, Cost, Reliability

title: NASA Mission Viz
scope: GMAT-derived Cartesian trajectories (ECI J2000 state vectors) and Kepler orbit propagator

title: JWST Build It Yourself Satellite Game
scope: gametext.pdf rules: 5 science goals, wavelength compatibility, optics rules, 7 flagship benchmarks

title: CubeSat 101 Basic Concepts and Processes (CSLI)
scope: 1U-12U standard envelopes, 30-min deployer inhibit, 45-min RF silence timer, UL 1642 battery safety

title: Visualize a Space Mission Using VR
scope: Flight trajectory profiles: LEO, SSO, GEO, Earth-Moon transfer (TLI/LOI), Earth-Mars Aldrin cycler

title: Canadian Space Agency Digital Games & Activities
scope: Real CSA flight payloads: RADARSAT Constellation (RCM SAR), OSIRIS-REx OLA LIDAR, and space biology
